## Batch 51 handoff

Authored all 22 assigned A/B carriers and completed the batch manifest, coverage, source evidence, proof contracts, cross-batch dependencies, notes, and Step 1 records. The manifest’s dependency levels recompute correctly from batches 50 and 51.

**14 items are marked ready; 8 are escalated.** The escalations preserve the full assigned claims and identify three unresolved proofs:

- [thm-semiconvex-hilbert-gradient-flow](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-semiconvex-hilbert-gradient-flow.md): Step 6.1 does not establish the energy chain rule or rule out a singular part.
- [lem-characteristics-unique-and-stable](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-characteristics-unique-and-stable.md): the law-level stability proof is present; the nonautonomous characteristic-map existence proof remains unresolved.
- [lem-localized-lift-generates-continuity-equation](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-localized-lift-generates-continuity-equation.md): the continuity equation and finite-action AC² curve are proved; minimum-action orthogonality remains unresolved.

The localized and global flow, escape, particle-limit, and quadratic-flow carriers are escalated because they depend on those proofs.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (22 items, 58 steps), precheck (18 proof-bearing items), content policy, statement-first (22 items), strict proof contracts (18/18), source fetch (2/2), and dependency levels (43 combined items). The proof-contract checker reported one nonfatal shotgun-bracket warning on the escalated Hilbert-flow theorem.

Run-wide checks remain blocked by work outside this dispatch: the item-level checker reports 83 empty scaffold inventories; the batch-level checker cannot parse the unquoted colon in [alg-nystrom-kernel-ridge-fit.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/alg-nystrom-kernel-ridge-fit.md); and the run-wide statement check stops at an empty batch 10 page. The autopilot run remains held at `1-scaffold` by the existing owner blocker. I left those shared items and engine state unchanged.
